prompts.text: Create a practical, self-contained example showing C, Python, and SQL working together to ingest sensor readings, calculate a rolling average, and store/query alerts. Include complete code blocks, error handling, build or run commands, and a concise explanation. Do not omit implementation details.

Return one complete standalone SVG and nothing outside the SVG. Create a polished technical infographic showing a CPU inference pipeline: tokenize, long-context prefill, KV or recurrent state, decode, and detokenize. Use a viewBox, title, description, readable labels, arrows, restrained colors, and multiple meaningful visual elements. Do not use scripts or external assets.
